title: The Heart of Gratitude: A Key to Unlocking the Peace and Presence of
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges us to cultivate a spirit of gratitude in our lives, exploring how thankfulness is not only a vital part of our faith, but also a key to unlocking the peace of God in our hearts. By examining Scripture, Pastor Chris shows us why gratitude is essential to our spiritual maturity and our ability to hold onto the blessings God has given us. Join us as we discover the transformative power of gratitude and learn how to live a life of thankfulness that pleases God.
